description: Look up a registered HTTP field (header or trailer) name. Pass exactly one of `name` (case-insensitive, e.g. "Cache-Status") or `keyword` (words matched against field names and comments). Returns the registration status — permanent, provisional, deprecated, or obsoleted — the Structured Field type when registered, and the defining reference. Many widely used headers are unregistered; a miss means only that IANA has no entry.

keyword.description: Words matched as whole tokens against field names and registry comments, e.g. "cache". Pass this or name, not both.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return, 1–100. Default 25.

name.description: Exact field name, case-insensitive, e.g. "Content-Type" (a trailing ":" is ignored). Pass this or keyword, not both.

offset.description: Number of keyword matches to skip; pass the next_offset of the previous response to get the next page. Default 0.

status.description: Keep only fields with this registration status. Applies to both modes.

name: iana_lookup_http_field

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `mode_required`: Neither or both of name and keyword were given. `upstream_unreadable`: The HTTP field registry file could not be fetched or parsed. `pacer_shed`: This server's own iana.org request queue is too full for the call to start in time. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fields.description: Matching fields: exact name hits first, then registry order.

name.description: The registered field name, registry casing.

id.description: E.g. "RFC 9110", a draft name, a registry id, or a URL.

label.description: Label text, when it adds to id and section.

status.description: Lowercased: permanent, provisional, deprecated, or obsoleted.

structured_type.description: Structured Field type (List, Dictionary, Item), when registered.

found.description: True when a registered field matched.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; absent on the last.

notice.description: Guidance on a miss, a cut list, or another condition.

source.description: Provenance and freshness of the answer.

fetched_at.description: ISO 8601 time of the last successful fetch or revalidation.

registry_id.description: Id of the registry file that answered.

registry_updated.description: The registry's own last-updated date; absent for the protocol index.

stale.description: True when a refresh failed and a cached copy up to 7 days old answered.

totalCount.description: Matches before the limit was applied.

truncated.description: True when more matches exist than were returned.

title: Look up an HTTP field name
